hf_onnx_parity.detail: Variant 1 frame 141 raw PASS (logits 1.4e-4). Frame 283 raw slots differ (1.79) because near-tied encoder top-300 proposal scores (gaps 2.4e-6 and 7.9e-6 at ranks 98/99 and 219/220) reorder under rounding-level differences; RF-DETR pairs each slot with a learned query, so reordering changes low-confidence slot values. Person decodes are identical in count and query order (score delta <= 4.9e-4). Variant 2 shows the same near-tie effect on frame 141. Order-independent strict person sets (one-to-one, IoU>=0.5, score delta<=0.02) match 41/41 and 43/43 for both variants.

tensorrt_engine_build.precision: FP32 --stronglyTyped --noTF32, no FP16 flag; TensorRT 10.16 in the pinned DeepStream 9.2 image

variant_2.detail: TensorRT and ONNX Runtime take different near-tie orders; person sets 41/41 and 43/43 (score delta <= 0.006, box <= 2.6 px).

deepstream_preprocessing.result: VARIANT 1 REJECTED, VARIANT 2 ADOPTED FOR THE CANDIDATE
deepstream_preprocessing.variant_1_finding: Both nvinfer settings are closest to top-left nearest sampling (0.0058 / 0.012), not torch half-pixel bilinear without antialias.
deepstream_preprocessing.variant_2_residual: Uniform ~-0.002 per channel (about -0.5/255), consistent with YUV->RGB rounding differences.

deepstream_like_for_like_variant_2.engine_in_deepstream_raw_slots: FAIL (near-tie reordering on frame 141; frame 283 1.01e-3 logits, just above 1e-3)
deepstream_like_for_like_variant_2.nvdcf_effect: No box displacement (<= 6.1e-05 px); removes 2-3 detector objects per examined frame.

strict_end_to_end_crosscheck_unchanged_c.interpretation_limit: Remaining mismatches are near-threshold objects. The RT-DETR control showed two equally valid CPU references can also fail this criterion, but that does not convert this FAIL into a PASS.

deepstream_positive_integration.performance_scope: One 710-frame 1920x1080 clip, batch 1, FP32. No realtime, multi-stream, or capacity claim.

visual_sanity.detail: Frame 141 overlay: boxes lie on people; most scores < 0.5 in this dense crowd; many visible people unboxed at threshold 0.25. Qualitative only.

labeled_accuracy_and_quality_baseline_se.reason: No ground-truth labels. RT-DETR yields more boxes per frame (76 vs ~40 at 0.25 on frame 141) but box count is not accuracy; no winner can be claimed.

artifact_identities.note: The two variant-1 DeepStream diagnostic runs used the earlier 512-only parser build (library sha256 8434453a...; build-test-attempt-1-512-only.log).

variant_2_operational_constraint: Requires 1920x1080 nvstreammux output (non-1080p cameras would be rescaled by nvstreammux, reintroducing NvBufSurfTransform resampling). Full-frame FP32 input is about 24.9 MB per frame on the GPU.

Decide whether cross-pipeline detector agreement should be a documented sensitivity measurement instead of an acceptance gate; this needs a requirements decision and is not made here.
